thingsToDo.title: Wailea Beach
thingsToDo.description: Wailea Beach is a beach in or near Wailea-Makena, Hawaii. Wailea Beach is a crescent-shaped beach in South Maui fronting resort areas of Wailea. The beach is known for calm-season swimming conditions, shoreline paths, and its role in Wailea's planned resort and public-access coastal design. The site is regularly referenced in statewide historical, environmental, or cultural documentation. Its present-day access and management context shape how residents and visitors use the area.

thingsToDo.title: Mākena State Park
thingsToDo.description: Mākena State Park is a state park in or near Wailea-Makena, Hawaii. Mākena State Park in South Maui includes large sandy beaches and lava-rock shoreline, with areas widely known as Big Beach and Little Beach. The park preserves coastal habitat while supporting high-volume public beach recreation and ocean viewing. The site is regularly referenced in statewide historical, environmental, or cultural documentation.

thingsToDo.title: Molokini
thingsToDo.description: Molokini is a crescent islet and marine reserve in or near Wailea-Makena, Hawaii. Molokini is a crescent-shaped volcanic tuff islet off South Maui designated as a Marine Life Conservation District and seabird sanctuary. Clear-water conditions and protected status make it one of Hawaiʻi's best-known snorkeling and dive destinations. The site is regularly referenced in statewide historical, environmental, or cultural documentation.

thingsToDo.title: Keawalaʻi Church
thingsToDo.description: Keawalaʻi Church is a historic church in or near Wailea-Makena, Hawaii. Keawalaʻi Church in Mākena is a historic Congregational church established in the nineteenth century on South Maui's coast. The coral-lime structure and churchyard are associated with missionary-era religious history and Hawaiian community continuity. The site is regularly referenced in statewide historical, environmental, or cultural documentation. Its present-day access and management context shape how residents and visitors use the area.

thingsToDo.title: Wailea Alanui Drive
thingsToDo.description: Wailea Alanui Drive is a coastal corridor in or near Wailea-Makena, Hawaii. Wailea Alanui Drive is the principal roadway through Wailea's master-planned resort district, linking beaches, hotels, and residential neighborhoods. The corridor reflects late twentieth-century resort infrastructure development on South Maui's leeward coast. The site is regularly referenced in statewide historical, environmental, or cultural documentation. Its present-day access and management context shape how residents and visitors use the area.
